name: meeting-capture
title: Meeting Capture
description: Record meeting system audio and microphone to local MP3 files with private on-device transcripts
author: bui_tr_ng_khanh_duy

preferences.name: outputDirectory
preferences.title: Recording Folder
preferences.description: Local folder for timestamped MP3 recordings and plain-text transcripts

preferences.name: transcriptLanguage
preferences.title: Transcript Language
preferences.description: Choose the Apple on-device recognition language. Required models are installed automatically after the MP3 is saved.

commands.name: start-meeting-capture
commands.title: Start Meeting Capture
commands.description: Start recording system audio and microphone for a new meeting

commands.name: pause-meeting-capture
commands.title: Pause Meeting Capture
commands.description: Pause the active meeting recording and exclude paused time

commands.name: continue-meeting-capture
commands.title: Continue Meeting Capture
commands.description: Continue a paused meeting recording using the same output files

commands.name: stop-meeting-capture
commands.title: Stop Meeting Capture
commands.description: Stop recording, finalize the MP3, and create an on-device transcript

commands.name: toggle-meeting-capture
commands.title: Toggle Meeting Capture
commands.description: Start when idle or stop an active meeting capture
